OFFER TO PURCHASE FOR CASH
Up to 1,200,000 Shares of Common Stock
of
MERIDIAN INDUSTRIAL HOLDINGS, INC.
at
$18.75 Net Per Share in Cash

THE OFFER AND WITHDRAWAL RIGHTS WILL EXPIRE AT 5:00 P.M., NEW YORK CITY TIME, ON NOVEMBER 12, 2026, UNLESS THE OFFER IS EXTENDED (SUCH DATE, AS IT MAY BE EXTENDED, THE “EXPIRATION DATE”).

Meridian Industrial Holdings, Inc., a Delaware corporation, hereby offers to purchase for cash up to 1,200,000 shares of its common stock, par value $0.01 per share, at a purchase price of $18.75 per share, net to the seller in cash, less any applicable withholding taxes and without interest.

If more than 1,200,000 Shares are validly tendered and not properly withdrawn, we will purchase Shares on a pro rata basis from all tendering shareholders, except for Odd Lot Holders as described below.

Will I be subject to proration if I own fewer than 100 Shares? No. If you own, beneficially or of record, fewer than 100 Shares in the aggregate, you validly tender all of those Shares before the Expiration Date and you complete the section entitled “Odd Lots” in the Letter of Transmittal, we will accept all of your Shares for payment before proration, if any, of the Shares tendered by other shareholders. This preference is not available to you if you tender fewer than all of the Shares you own, or if you own 100 or more Shares in the aggregate, even if those Shares are held in separate accounts or represented by separate certificates.

Shares tendered may be withdrawn at any time prior to the Expiration Date.

The Offer is not conditioned upon the receipt of financing or upon any minimum number of Shares being tendered.
